achievements.name: Clincher
achievements.description: 100 enemies shot in the head. Not bad for a head start…

achievements.name: Goodnight
achievements.description: Get 20 covert kills. The Zone likes it quiet.

achievements.name: On the go
achievements.description: Bread and sausage — Zone's most popular sandwich recipe.

achievements.name: Tit for tat
achievements.description: Sidorovich's worst nightmare: buy and sell goods for the exact same amount of coupons in one deal.

achievements.name: First touches
achievements.description: First equipment enhancement. Never the last, for most Zone folks.

achievements.name: The good, the bad and the ugly
achievements.description: 5 headshots in 10 seconds. Good eye.

achievements.name: Bingo
achievements.description: Experience the effects of bleeding, sleep, hunger, alcohol, radiation and psi. Doesn't sound pretty.

achievements.name: Zone's deadliest predator
achievements.description: Kill a mutant of every kind. You'll need a bigger wall to fit all those trophies!

achievements.name: Pump it up
achievements.description: Fully enhance any type of weapon. Somewhere out there, a Zone technician just shed a tear of pride..

achievements.name: The four winds
achievements.description: Unlock the whole map. Few folks know the Zone this well.

achievements.name: Taking it for granted
achievements.description: Gear broken beyond repair. Don't forget to pay regular visits to the technician.

achievements.name: Miracle hoarder
achievements.description: Collect all artifacts. What about arch-artifacts?

achievements.name: Curiouser and curiouser!
achievements.description: Collect all arch-artifacts. A priceless collection, arguably too weird, even by Zone standards.

achievements.name: No obstacle too big…
achievements.description: Kill 50 enemies through obstacles. No one in the Zone is really safe.

achievements.name: BOOM!
achievements.description: 20 enemies killed by blowing up the surroundings. Save on hand grenades and enjoy the fireworks.

achievements.name: Personal approach
achievements.description: One fight, four enemies, killed by different weapons. That trick would charm the hell out of Mavka!

achievements.name: Loner shooter
achievements.description: Shoot an enemy in the head from 75 meters. No scope-peeking!

achievements.name: Merry-go-round
achievements.description: Drop a corpse into the Whirlgig anomaly. A joy for someone who never got to ride the Ferris Wheel.

achievements.name: Keeping your hands steady
achievements.description: Shoot an enemy in the head, through an obstacle, having the intoxication effect.

achievements.name: Catching up
achievements.description: Shoot an incoming grenade to make it explode. Nice view!

achievements.name: Flash Royal
achievements.description: Gather all armor and gear enhancement flash drives.

achievements.name: Wiped out
achievements.description: Kill a Rodent using a grenade launcher. A good wipe-out makes the Duty proud.

achievements.name: Can opener
achievements.description: Use a knife to kill an enemy wearing an exoskeleton. Epic battle indeed.

achievements.name: Coupons to burn
achievements.description: Spend over 1,000,000 coupons. Myklukha and Sidorovich will fight hard over their favorite customer.

achievements.name: Bouncy
achievements.description: A successful jump from a 30-meter height. No parachute, though.

achievements.name: Run, stalker, run!
achievements.description: That Chimera made you run like an Olympic champion!

achievements.name: Peace and quiet
achievements.description: Kill everyone in the camp before the alarm is set off. They couldn't see it coming!

achievements.name: Proxy
achievements.description: Kill a squad that just finished off another squad and won the fight. Or so they thought…

achievements.name: Lockpick
achievements.description: Lure a mutant into an anomaly. Hardly a noble deed, but it gets the job done.

achievements.name: Welcome to the Zone
achievements.description: Prologue complete, but this is so far from over.

achievements.name: Such is the will of the Monolith
I see you have many questions
Goss
achievements.description: Join Stalkers for some campfire gossip.

achievements.name: The end of the Golden Era
In the heart of the enemy
Battle on – and win your battle!
